target.title: fix(openai): add timeout to realtime client-secret requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenAI Realtime client-secret creation could wait indefinitely when the client-secret endpoint accepted the POST but never returned a response.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Realtime voice and transcription secret paths share `createOpenAIRealtimeSecret`, so the timeout is applied once at the existing `fetchWithSsrFGuard` boundary. The change preserves the current SSRF allowlist, request body shape, auth headers, bounded response parsing, and 401 remediation behavior.

## User Impact

A stalled OpenAI-compatible client-secret endpoint no longer blocks Realtime session setup forever. Callers receive a bounded timeout-class rejection and can surface the existing setup failure path.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/openai/realtime-provider-shared.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  6 passed (6)`.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/openai/realtime-provider-shared.ts extensions/openai/realtime-provider-shared.test.ts` - passed.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/openai/realtime-provider-shared.ts extensions/openai/realtime-provider-shared.test.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check upstream/main..HEAD` - passed; exit 0.
- Open PR collision check: searched open PR topics and scanned the latest 500 open PR changed-file lists; no open PR touched `extensions/openai/realtime-provider-shared.ts`.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: OpenAI Realtime client-secret POSTs now carry a deadline when the remote endpoint accepts the request but never sends a response.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; real `node:http` loopback server that accepts the POST and deliberately never responds. The test also first verifies a bare fetch to the same hanging server remains pending without a deadline.

Exact command run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/openai/realtime-provider-shared.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the focused regression drives the exported `createOpenAIRealtimeClientSecret` path, verifies `timeoutMs: 20000` is passed to the guarded fetch call, and observes the hanging server request reject with a timeout-class error instead of staying pending.

What was not tested: live OpenAI traffic; the hang is reproduced with a real local HTTP server, not the real third-party service.
